cases.question: ¿Cuánto se registró en ventas en efectivo y otros medios por caja en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS total_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS total_otros FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.opened_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND cs.opened_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue la diferencia total de las sesiones cerradas de caja en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.difference), 0) AS diferencia FROM cash_session cs WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-02-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto dinero se movió por tipo de movimiento de caja en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cm.type, SUM(cm.amount) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY cm.type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cm.type AS type, SUM(cm.amount) AS total_amount FROM public.cash_movement AS cm WHERE cm.created_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND cm.created_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cm.type LIMIT 50
